Hodge Center]] |champion= |tourney= |tourney_result= }} {{2018–19 Big South men's basketball standings}} The '''2018–19 USC Upstate Spartans men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of South Carolina Upstate]] during the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Spartans, led by first-year head coach [[Dave Dickerson]], played their home games at the [[G. B. Hodge Center]] in [[Spartanburg, South Carolina]] as first-year members of the [[Big South Conference]]. ==Previous season== The [[2017–18 USC Upstate Spartans men's basketball team|Spartans]] finished the [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2017–18 season]] 7–25, 2–12 in [[Atlantic Sun Conference|ASUN]] play to finish in last place. They lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2018 Atlantic Sun men's basketball tournament|ASUN tournament]] to [[2017–18 Florida Gulf Coast Eagles men's basketball team|Florida Gulf Coast]]. After the season, USC Upstate fired head coach Kyle Perry on March 1, less than five months after being named full-time head coach of the Spartans.{{cite news|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/22615375/south-carolina-upstate-spartans-fire-ad-julio-freire-basketball-coach-kyle-perry|title=South Carolina Upstate fires AD Julio Freire, coach Kyle Perry|work=ESPN.com|first=Jeff|last=Goodman|date=March 1, 2018|accessdate=March 1, 2018}} On March 30, the school hired former [[Tulane Green Wave men's basketball|Tulane]] head coach [[Dave Dickerson]] for the job.{{cite news|url=http://www.goupstate.com/news/20180330/usc-upstate-names-new-mens-basketball-coach|title=USC Upstate names new men’s basketball
